neighbours.label: 'right' in 'the right X' after a choosing verb ('choosing/making/taking the right …')
fire: Picking the right school for your child takes careful thought.
Hiring the right people is the hardest part of running a firm.
We spent weeks selecting the right venue for the wedding.
Finding the right words at a funeral is never easy.
Choosing the right tyres can save fuel in winter.
The key is taking the right steps before the market opens.
She is good at making the right calls under pressure.
Getting the right balance between work and rest matters.
